title: A2/R-157-R-158 exact-core Lean cross-check
question: Can a short Lean kernel sidecar increase assurance for the exact rational cores already used by R-157 and R-158 without changing the existing forward, inverse, owner-order, or promotion-firewall methods?
method: Hash-pin the existing A1 P1, A2 PDE, R-157 and R-158 manifests as authorities.
Encode only the listed rational identities and inequalities in verification/lean/Tect/R472.lean and compile them with the pinned Lean 4.32.1 toolchain.
Recompute the same constants from A1 parameters in a primary Fraction lane and a non-importing independent Fraction lane.
Run hostile mutations of signs, denominators, densities, charges, tier flags, method flags and Lean markers; integrate all lanes.
Keep the result T0, claim-nonbearing, no-PDF and no-new-negative, then return the mainline to the unchanged source-owner/common-core/uniform-estimate order.
finding: The Lean kernel, primary and independent exact lanes agree on the R-157/R-158 rational core; primary 30/30, independent 22/22, hostile 12/12 with ten mutations rejected, integrated 22/22 and Lean compilation pass. The sidecar does not supply a new dynamics or physical premise.
decision_reason: R-471 left the production owner fail-closed and the physical-empty route input-blocked. A short exact-algebra cross-check improves assurance for already accepted A2 results without repeating a blocked route or changing any research method.
boundary: This is a T0 kernel/arithmetic audit only. It does not prove the full R-157/R-158 analytic theorem and does not admit source-owned dynamics, common-core compatibility, uniform limits, physical identity, observation prediction, Pre-A, Sector-A, QFT, Yang-Mills, gravity, continuum or mass gap.
next_action: Preserve R-472 as a sidecar and pursue the existing source-owned dynamics, common-core and cutoff/volume/lattice-uniform gates; do not rerun physical-empty tests without a new owner-approved common functional and explicit empty branch.
assumptions: The hash-pinned A1 P1 parameters and R-157/R-158 manifests remain authoritative.
R-157 and R-158 hypotheses and their T6 conditional boundaries are unchanged.
The encoded Lean propositions are exact finite consequences and do not stand in for their analytic source proofs.
missing_assumptions: A source-owned production generator or transfer, state, physical projection and time boundary.
A common core and uniform regulator/volume/limit estimate.
Physical charge/observation correspondence, holdout data and QFT/Yang-Mills/gravity identification.
evidence_level: T0 exact kernel cross-check with independent arithmetic and hostile mutation rejection
non_claims: No PDE or full variational theorem is newly proved.
No physical owner, Reading-H sign, physical vacuum, Pre-A, Sector-A, QFT, Yang-Mills, continuum or mass-gap conclusion is admitted.
Existing T-054/T-059/T-061 methods, owner order and promotion firewalls are unchanged.
stop_or_redesign: If an authority hash or Lean source hash drifts, stop and repair the package before citing it.
If primary and independent exact values disagree, stop and investigate rather than selecting one value.
If a mutation is accepted, withdraw the sidecar and repair its acceptance firewall.
If no source-owned input hash arrives, keep the physical-owner branch fail-closed and return to the declared mainline gate.
